Wind Walker.label: Wind Walker
Wind Walker.description:
Wind Walker
Max Lv : 10
Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 9
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : Increases Movement Speed and FLEE Rate of the caster and party members within a 13 x 13 cell area around self.
Movement Speed increase does not apply if Increase Agility or other Movement Speed–increasing effects are active.
The Movement Speed bonus is removed if affected by Quagmire or other Movement Speed–reducing effects.

Ruwach.label: Ruwach
Ruwach.description:
Ruwach
Max Lv : 1
Category : Active
Type : Support, Magic
Target : Instant Cast
Description : Reveals all hidden targets within a 5 x 5 cell area around the caster for 10 seconds.
If a revealed target is an enemy, deals Holy Magical Damage equal to MATK 145%.

Shattering Strike.label: Shattering Strike
Shattering Strike.description:
Shattering Strike
Max Lv : 10
Prerequisite : Skin Tempering Lv. 3, Hilt Binding Lv. 1, Weaponry Research Lv. 5, Power Thrust Lv. 3
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : While Shattering Strike is active, attacking players has a chance to destroy their weapon or armor, while attacking monsters reduces their ATK or DEF.
The destruction chance increases with skill level.
Additionally, increases the caster’s damage for the duration, with further damage increased based on the caster’s LUK.
[Lv 1] Additional Damage: 100, Duration 30 sec
[Lv 2] Additional Damage: 200, Duration 40 sec
[Lv 3] Additional Damage: 300, Duration 50 sec
[Lv 4] Additional Damage: 400, Duration 60 sec
[Lv 5] Additional Damage: 500, Duration 70 sec
[Lv 6] Additional Damage: 600, Duration 80 sec
[Lv 7] Additional Damage: 700, Duration 90 sec
[Lv 8] Additional Damage: 800, Duration 100 sec
[Lv 9] Additional Damage: 900, Duration 110 sec
[Lv 10] Additional Damage: 1000, Duration 120 sec

Magnificat.label: Magnificat
Magnificat.description:
Magnificat
Max Lv : 5
Category : Active
Type : Buff
Target : Instant Cast
Description : Doubles the natural SP recovery rate of the caster and party members on screen for a set duration.
[Lv 1] Duration: 30 sec
[Lv 2] Duration: 45 sec
[Lv 3] Duration: 60 sec
[Lv 4] Duration: 75 sec
[Lv 5] Duration: 90 sec

Cart Boost.label: Cart Boost
Cart Boost.description:
Cart Boost
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Pushcart Lv. 5, Cart Revolution Lv. 1, Change Cart Lv. 1
Prerequisite : Pushcart Lv. 3
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : While Cart Boost is active, increases Movement Speed when a cart is equipped.
Allows the caster to ignore Decrease Agility and other Movement Speed–reducing effects.

Stealth.label: Stealth
Stealth.description:
Stealth
Max Lv : 5
Prerequisite : Hiding Lv. 5, Stalk Lv. 3
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : Move while concealed under Hiding.
Cannot be detected by Sight, Ruwach, or Improve Concentration.
Unlike Hiding, takes damage from area-of-effect attacks and leaves footprints while moving.
Ineffective against Insect, Demon, and Boss monsters.
Attacking and using skills is disabled while active.
Usable in Siege Mode, but SP consumption is increased by 5 times.
Natural SP recovery is disabled while active.
[Lv 1] Movement Speed 70%, SP Consumption 12 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +1
[Lv 2] Movement Speed 75%, SP Consumption 14 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +2
[Lv 3] Movement Speed 80%, SP Consumption 16 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +4
[Lv 4] Movement Speed 85%, SP Consumption 18 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +8
[Lv 5] Movement Speed 90%, SP Consumption 20 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +16

Counter Instinct.label: Counter Instinct
Counter Instinct.description:
Counter Instinct
Max Lv : 5
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : If the enemy is using a sword-type weapon, has a chance to deflect the attack, reducing damage taken by 50%.
The deflection chance increases with skill level.
Up to 3 attacks can be deflected after using the skill.
Applies to attacks from all monsters.
Deflected damage is reflected back to the attacker.
[Lv 1] Reflect Chance 15%
[Lv 2] Reflect Chance 30%
[Lv 3] Reflect Chance 45%
[Lv 4] Reflect Chance 60%
[Lv 5] Reflect Chance 75%

Arrow Vulcan.label: Arrow Vulcan
Arrow Vulcan.description:
Arrow Vulcan

Prerequisite : Double Strafe Lv. 5, Arrow Shower Lv. 5, Melody Strike Lv. 1 (Slinging Arrow Lv. 1)
Category : Active
Type : Ranged Physical
Target : Single Target
Description : Rapidly fires a large number of Arrows at a single target.
Bard requires an instrument equipped, and Dancer requires a whip equipped.

[Lv 2] ATK 1400%

[Lv 4] ATK 1800%

Sheltering Bliss.label: Sheltering Bliss
Sheltering Bliss.description:
Sheltering Bliss
Max Lv : 5
Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 5, Music Lessons Lv. 7
Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 5, Dance Lessons Lv. 7
Category : Active
Type : Ensemble Skill
Target : Instant Cast
Description : An ensemble skill performed by Bard and Dancer.
Creates a barrier in a 5 x 5 cells area around the performer that prevents entry.
The barrier does not block magic or ranged attacks.
Cannot be activated if there are obstacles nearby.
[Lv 1] Duration 20 sec
[Lv 2] Duration 25 sec
[Lv 3] Duration 30 sec
[Lv 4] Duration 35 sec
[Lv 5] Duration 40 sec

Marionette Control.label: Marionette Control
Marionette Control.description:
Marionette Control
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Music Lessons Lv. 5
Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Dance Lessons Lv. 5
Category : Active
Type : Buff
Target : Single Target
Description : Transfers all of the caster’s base stats to the target.
The target receives half of each stat transferred, up to a maximum of 99 per stat.
The effect is canceled if the distance between the caster and the target exceeds 7 cells.

Clashing Spiral.label: Clashing Spiral
Clashing Spiral.description:
Clashing Spiral
Category : Active / Damage
Description : Thrusts a spear to unleash a spiraling, multi-hit attack with enhanced piercing power.
Damage increases with weapon weight and immobilizes the target for 1 sec.
Higher Skill Lv increases damage but also increases casting time.

Traumatic Blow.label: Traumatic Blow
Traumatic Blow.description:
Traumatic Blow
Max Lv : 5
Prerequisite : Spear Mastery Lv. 9, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1
Category : Active
Type : Ranged Physical
Target : Single Target
Description : Strikes the target with a powerful blow, with a chance to inflict Bleeding.
Bleeding targets take additional damage over time.

[Lv 2] ATK 180%
[Lv 3] ATK 220%
[Lv 4] ATK 260%
[Lv 5] ATK 300%

Vital Strike.label: Vital Strike

Vital Strike

Prerequisite : Spear Mastery Lv. 9, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1, Cavalier Mastery Lv. 3, Traumatic Blow Lv. 3
Category : Active
Type : Ranged Physical
Target : Single Target
Description : Usable only while wielding a spear.
Attacks the target’s joints to inflict various effects.
As skill level increases, both damage and the chance to inflict Status Ailment increase.

Pneuma

23Prerequisite : Warp Portal Lv. 2

Type : Support
Target : Ground (1 Cell)
Description : Creates a protective area at the designated location and within a 3 x 3 cell radius for 10 seconds, blocking ranged physical damage.

Napalm Vulcan.label: Napalm Vulcan
Napalm Vulcan.description:
Napalm Vulcan
Max Lv : 5
Prerequisite : Napalm Beat Lv. 5
Category : Active
Type : Magic
Target : Single Target
Description : Uses psychokinesis to deal Ghost Magical Damage to a distant target and all enemies in a 3 x 3 area around it, with a low chance to inflict Curse.
As skill level increases, the number of hits increases, and damage scales with the caster’s Base Level.
[Lv 1] MATK 70%, Hits: 1
[Lv 2] MATK 140%, Hits: 2
[Lv 3] MATK 210%, Hits: 3
[Lv 4] MATK 280%, Hits: 4

Zen.label: Zen
Zen.description:
Zen
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Fury Lv. 5
Prerequisite : Fury Lv. 3
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Instant Cast
Description : A technique that gathers inner energy at great risk, instantly summoning up to 5 Spirit Spheres required for Summon Spirit Sphere.

Mind Breaker.label: Mind Breaker
Mind Breaker.description:
Mind Breaker
Max Lv : 5
Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 3, Soul Siphon Lv. 2
Category : Active
Type : Debuff
Target : Single Target
Description : Attacks the target’s mind, causing mental collapse.
Decreases the target’s magic defense while increasing magic attack power.
Success rate increases with skill level.
[Lv 1] Target MATK +20%, MDEF −12%
[Lv 2] Target MATK +40%, MDEF −24%
[Lv 3] Target MATK +60%, MDEF −36%
[Lv 4] Target MATK +80%, MDEF −48%
[Lv 5] Target MATK +100%, MDEF −60%

Foresight.label: Foresight
Foresight.description:
Foresight
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Study Lv. 5, Free Cast Lv. 5, Hindsight Lv. 1
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : After using Foresight, the next 5 skill casts have their Variable Casting Time reduced by half.
The effect remains until all uses are consumed, and is removed upon death.
The casting time of Foresight itself is fixed at 5 sec and is not affected by DEX.

Blinding Mist.label: Blinding Mist
Blinding Mist.description:
Blinding Mist
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Whirlwind Lv. 2, Deluge Lv. 2
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Ground (1 Cell)
Description : Creates a wall of fog in a 5 x 3 area, inflicting Blind on players or monsters and making attacks more difficult.
Ranged attacks and magic cast on targets within the area have reduced damage and an increased chance to miss.
In normal fields, the effect applies only to monsters, while in PvP zones it also applies to players.

Fiber Lock.label: Fiber Lock
Fiber Lock.description:
Fiber Lock
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Study Lv. 9
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Single Target
Description : Consumes 1 Cobweb.
Fires a Cobweb to bind the target. Up to 2 webs can be active at the same time.
Lasts for 8 sec. Monsters bound by Cobweb have their FLEE Rate reduced by half.
If a bound target is hit by a Fire-Property attack, it takes double damage and is released from the Cobweb.
Has no effect on Boss monsters.

Meteor Assault.label: Meteor Assault
Meteor Assault.description:
Meteor Assault
Max Lv : 10
Prerequisite : Katar Mastery Lv. 5, Righthand Mastery Lv. 3, Sonic Blow Lv. 5, Soul Destroyer Lv. 1
Category : Active
Type : Melee Physical
Target : Instant Cast
Description : Strikes all targets in a 5 x 5 area around the caster with a powerful blow.
Enemies hit have a chance to be inflicted with Stun, Blind, or Bleeding.
Damage increases based on the caster’s AGI and Base Level.
[Lv 1] ATK 320%
[Lv 2] ATK 440%
[Lv 3] ATK 560%
[Lv 4] ATK 680%
[Lv 5] ATK 800%

Create Deadly Poison.label: Create Deadly Poison
Create Deadly Poison.description:
Create Deadly Poison
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Envenom Lv. 10, Detoxify Lv. 1, Enchant Poison Lv. 5
Category : Active
Type : Support
Description : Creates a deadly poison using various materials and obtains 1 Poison Bottle.
Required materials: Poison Fang, Cactus Needle, Bee Sting, Poison Mushroom Spore, Karvodailnirol, Frenzy Potion, and Empty Bottle (1 each).
Success rate increases based on DEX and LUK. On failure, 25% of Max HP is lost.
When consumed by an Assassin Cross, it inflicts poison but increases attack speed. If consumed by other players, it causes immediate Suicide.

Mom, Dad, I love you!.label: Mom, Dad, I love you!
Mom, Dad, I love you!.description:
Mom, Dad, I love you!
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Adoption-exclusive skill (Baby).
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : Consumes 10% of Max SP to grant your parents the effect of not losing EXP upon death for 2 min.

Mom, Dad, I miss you!.label: Mom, Dad, I miss you!
Mom, Dad, I miss you!.description:
Mom, Dad, I miss you!
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Adoption-exclusive skill (Baby).
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : Summons your parents to your current location.
Cannot be used in areas where Warp Portal is unavailable or on Siege maps.

Come to me, honey~.label: Come to me, honey~
Come to me, honey~.description:
Come to me, honey~
Prerequisite : Adoption-exclusive skill (Parent).
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : Summons your Baby to your current location.
Cannot be used in areas where Warp Portal is unavailable or on Siege maps.

Teleport.label: Teleport
Teleport.description:
Teleport
Max Lv : 2
Prerequisite : Ruwach Lv. 1
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Instant Cast
Description : Instantly moves the caster to another location.
Cannot be used while under the effect of Land Protector.
[Lv 1] Teleports to a random location on the current map
[Lv 2] Teleports to the save point

Warp Portal.label: Warp Portal
Warp Portal.description:
Warp Portal
Max Lv : 4
Prerequisite : Teleport Lv. 2
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Ground (1 Cell)
Description : Creates a dimensional portal at the designated location that transports players to another area. Up to 8 players can be transported regardless of skill level, and 1 Blue Gemstone is consumed.
Cannot be used while under the effect of Land Protector.
[Lv 1] Teleports to the save point
[Lv 2] Allows use of 1 custom location
[Lv 3] Allows use of 2 custom locations
[Lv 4] Allows use of 3 custom locations
[Custom Location] Refers to a memorized location. Use the [/memo] command on the desired map to register it.

Permanent Development.label: Permanent Development
Permanent Development.description:
Permanent Development
Category : Passive
Description : When Development increases, there is a 50% chance to gain an additional +1 Development, allowing an increase of 1 or 2 at once.

Go! Parents Go!.label: Go! Parents Go!
Go! Parents Go!.description:
Go! Parents Go!
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Adoption-exclusive skill (Baby).
Category : Active
Type : Buff
Target : Self
Description : Grants parents within a 7 x 7 area around self +3 to all stats for 60 sec.

Heal.label: Heal
Heal.description:
Heal
Max Lv : 10
14Prerequisite : Faith Lv. 10
Category : Active
Type : Recovery
Target : Single Target
Description : Recovers the target player’s HP. In addition to the base Heal effect determined by skill level, the recovery amount is further increased based on the caster’s level, total INT, and the base and refined magic attack power of the equipped weapon.
When used on Undead-Property monsters, deals special Holy Magical Damage equal to 50% of the Heal effect.

Double Strafe.label: Double Strafe
Double Strafe.description:
Double Strafe
Max Lv : 10
Prerequisite : Vulture's Eye Lv. 10
Category : Active
Type : Ranged Physical
Target : Single Target
Description : Fires a single Arrow at the target, striking twice.
The base range of Double Strafe is 9 cells.
[Lv 1] ATK 100% × 2 hits
[Lv 2] ATK 110% × 2 hits

Weapon Quicken

Increase Agility
Max Lv : 10
4Prerequisite : Heal Lv. 3
23Prerequisite : Heal Lv. 2
Category : Active
Type : Buff
Target : Single Target
Description : Increases the target’s movement speed for a certain duration and additionally increases ASPD (reduces After Attack Delay). Consumes an additional 15 HP upon use.

Preserve

Category : Active (Toggle)

Full Divestment

Target : Single Target

Description : Attempts to inflict [Status Ailment : Decrease Agility] on the target for a certain duration.

Category : Passive

[Lv 4] SP Consumption -16%
[Lv 5] SP Consumption -20%

Double Bolt

[Lv 4] Chance 70%, Duration 90 sec

Ganbantein.label: Ganbantein
Ganbantein.description:
Ganbantein
Max Lv : 1
Prerequisite : Sense Lv. 1, Ice Wall Lv. 1
Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Ground (1 Cell)
Description : Has a chance to cancel all ground-targeted spells within a 3 x 3 area centered on the target cell.
Consumes 1 Blue Gemstone and 1 Yellow Gemstone.
When used on Land Protector, removes Land Protector within a 3 x 3 area.
Gemstone consumption cannot be reduced by items or skills.

Gravitational Field.label: Gravitational Field
Gravitational Field.description:
Gravitational Field
Max Lv : 5
Prerequisite : Quagmire Lv. 1, Stave Crasher Lv. 1, Mystical Amplification Lv. 10
Category : Active
Type : Magic
Target : Ground (1 Cell)
Description : Creates a surge of gravity within a 5 x 5 area centered on the target cell, dealing Neutral Magical Damage.
The number of hits increases with skill level, and damage increases based on the caster’s Base Level.
[Lv 1] MATK 100%, Hits: 2
[Lv 2] MATK 200%, Hits: 4
[Lv 3] MATK 300%, Hits: 6
[Lv 4] MATK 400%, Hits: 8
[Lv 5] MATK 500%, Hits: 10

High Speed Cart Ram.label: High Speed Cart Ram
High Speed Cart Ram.description:
High Speed Cart Ram
Max Lv : 10
Prerequisite : Mammonite Lv. 10, Geneticist Cart Boost Lv. 1
Category : Active
Type : Melee Physical
Target : Single Target
Description : Can only be used while Geneticist Cart Boost is active.
Strikes a single enemy with a cart, consuming Zeny and having a chance to inflict Stun.
Damage increases with skill level and is affected by cart weight.
[Lv 1] Zeny Cost 600z, Stun Chance 5%

Maximum Power-Thrust

Category : Active
Type : Buff
Target : Self
Description : Consumes Zeny to greatly increase weapon attack power.
Unlike Power Thrust, this effect applies only to the caster.
The effect is removed when changing equipment.

Hermode's Rod.label: Hermode's Rod

Hermode's Rod

Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Dance Lessons Lv. 10
Category : Active
Type : Debuff
Target : Ensemble (Performance)
Description : Can only be used in Siege Mode when a Warp Zone is present nearby.
Removes all buff magic except Frenzy from all allied characters within range (excluding the caster) and renders them immune to magic.

[Lv 5] Duration 50 sec

Tarot Card of Fate.label: Tarot Card of Fate

Scribble

Battle Command.label: Battle Command
Battle Command.description:
Battle Command

Description : Usable only in Siege Mode. Can only be used by the guild Pub Playmate. For 60 sec, increases STR, INT, and DEX of all Guildsman within sight by 5.

Piece.label: Piece

Piece

Target : Guild Flag

Remover.label: Remover

Remover

Prerequisite : Slyness Lv. 1

Description : Removes graffiti applied by Piece and restores the flag to normal.

Let's Go Family.label: Let's Go Family

Let's Go Family

Family members must be in the same party.
Cannot be used in areas where Teleport is unavailable.

Slyness.label: Slyness
Slyness.description:
Slyness

Prerequisite : Divest Shield Lv. 3

Has no effect on boss monsters.

Cold Bolt

Defending Aura

Category : Active
Type : Support
Target : Self
Description : Shield-exclusive skill.
When used, reduces Ranged Physical Damage Taken by a significant amount.

Plagiarism

Allows you to memorize and use the last skill that hit you (excluding monster-only skills).
The maximum usable level of the memorized skill increases with skill level, but cannot exceed the original skill’s max level.
Memorized skills do not count as learned skills and are not affected by skill tree requirements or level-boosting effects.
Expanded classes and Transcendent 2nd class skills cannot be memorized.

Bomb

Aid Potion

Lady Luck

Bioethics.label: Bioethics
Bioethics.description:
Bioethics
Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Category : Passive
Description : Has no direct effect. This skill simply marks the beginning of the skill tree required to create a Homunculus.
For those who handle precious life, however, Bioethics can never be emphasized enough.

Biotechnology.label: Biotechnology
Biotechnology.description:
Biotechnology

Description : Learns the fundamentals of life creation.
Increases the success chance of using Creature Creation and increases your Homunculus’ MHP.

Frost Diver

23Prerequisite : Cold Bolt Lv. 3

Description : Deals Water Magical Damage to the target and has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Frozen].

Creature Creation

Cultivation.label: Cultivation
Cultivation.description:
Cultivation
Category : Support
Description : Cultivates an Embryo to create a Homunculus.
Success or failure is determined by chance, and the base success rate increases by skill level.

A successfully created Homunculus automatically becomes your active Homunculus.

Yggdrasil Dust.label: Yggdrasil Dust
Yggdrasil Dust.description:
Yggdrasil Dust
Dust fragments once clinging to the leaves of the World Tree, which reveal purifying power when gathered and used.
Cures Petrification, Blind, Curse, Poison, Decrease Agility, and Grampus Morph when used.

Flame Control.label: Flame Control
Flame Control.description:
Flame Control

Return to Eclage

Call Homunculus.description:
Call Homunculus

Prerequisite : Vaporize Lv. 1
Category : Active

Target : Instant Cast

Double Attack

Vaporize
